'''Lake Farnell''' was a lake located in the [[Broken Valley]], north of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sobrik]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. The [[Bugtown|Farnel Research Facility]] was built on the peninsula that jutted out into the center of the lake from the western side of the crater, and several rock spires jutted from the lake's surface.
